system.description: During Downtime, you can ride out with a Ger raiding party into the Hinterlands. Test Strength (DR14). Triumph: bring back 2d6 × 10 s of spoils and a trophy the clans will talk about. Success: bring back d6 × 10 s of spoils. Failure: you come back with nothing. Ruin: you come back alone, and begin your next adventure with one wound.
